description: Source code for a web scraper class 'TheCookingGuy' that extracts recipe information from thecookingguy.com, including ingredients, instructions, description, and yields.

classes.name: TheCookingGuy
classes.description: A scraper class for extracting recipe data from thecookingguy.com, inheriting from AbstractScraper.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname 'thecookingguy.com' for the scraper.

methods.name: total_time
methods.description: Raises FieldNotProvidedByWebsiteException indicating total time info is not available.

methods.name: yields
methods.description: Extracts and returns the yields information from the recipe page.

methods.name: ingredients
methods.description: Returns a list of ingredient strings from the recipe page.

methods.name: ingredient_groups
methods.description: Groups ingredients by purpose if specified, otherwise returns ungrouped ingredients.

methods.name: instructions
methods.description: Extracts and returns the cooking instructions as a string.

methods.name: site_name
methods.description: Returns the site name 'Sam The Cooking Guy'.
